notes.title: 🔨UPDATE V 1.1.0.3 IS LIVE
notes.notes:
Patch Notes – April 22, 2025
Performance Improvements & VR Compatibility Fixes

Performance Boost: Improved overall performance across all supported VR headsets.
High Refresh Rate Fix: Resolved issues on headsets running above 72Hz (e.g., Valve Index, Quest 3).
Camera Jitter:  Fixed camera stuttering experienced by users of high refresh rate headsets.

notes.title: 🔨🪲UPDATE V 1.1.0.2 IS LIVE🪲🔨
notes.notes:
😻UPDATE V 1.1.0.2:

•Hand Disappearance: Resolved the issue with hands disappearing during boxing bag interactions and object breaking.

•Transition Crash: Fixed crash occurring when transitioning between locations.

•Endless Music: Fixed the bug causing an endless music loop in the mouse game.

•Tutorial : Fixed the visual glitch with a hole in the tutorial level.

•Fall Animation: Improved fall animation for characters in the "Street" location.

•Character Disappearance: Fixed issue with characters disappearing on the stairs in the "Street" location.

•Wardrobe : Resolved the bug with incorrect nail display in the wardrobe mirror.

•Garage Location: Fixed the key bug in the car.

•Optimization for VALVE INDEX  

Update your game to the latest version, cats! 🐱

notes.title: RELEASE DATE ANNOUNCE
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049874/2ac0b457ff3fe7f76c406ab4e443c3d9dcbe0b85.png

Hey Cat lovers,

We are glad to announce that I Am Cat will be available starting from December 5!

Here’s a short overview of what’s new in the game:

New Locations
Beyond Granny’s house, players can now explore expanded locations, including a town map, garage, butcher’s shop, and more. These new areas add even more opportunities for exploration!

New Characters
Get ready to meet new characters, such as a playful dog or butcher. They might be friendly or foes depending on your actions!

New Mechanics
Dive into tons of new mechanics like:
- Cutting down trees
- Drive a lawn mover and cut the grass
- Painting on walls
- Shooting a slingshot
- New cooking recipes

And so much more! Full of freedom and creativity to your sandbox experience.

New Skins and Shop items
Customize your cat with three new skins, launching alongside the game on December 5. Make your cat unique! As well as new items are available in the shop!

New Quests
Exciting new quests await you, providing hours of engaging challenges and rewards.

We can’t wait to see how you embrace your inner cat and explore all the new content. See you on December 5!
